 Game Day Thread – Nashville Predators at San Jose Sharks
 Posted on November 15, 2026 November 8, 2026 by Laura _C 
 Feb 23, 2023; San Jose, California, USA; Nashville Predators defenseman Roman Josi (59) collides into San Jose Sharks right wing Kevin Labanc (62) during the second period at SAP Center at San Jose. Mandatory Credit: Stan Szeto-USA TODAY Sports 
 Welcome to the Game Day Thread for the Predators at Sharks game. This is on paper a “should win” game for the Preds. These are the ones that scare me the most. Let’s get out of California on a high note!
 Just a reminder – we’re always looking for new people to chat with and to be part of our community. Feel free to share the link to our thread with potential new members!
 Sunday 11/15 Nashville Predators at San Jose Sharks at 8pm Central on the Spot in Nashville, multiple stations in other locales and streaming for a fee on the Preds app.
 Go Preds!
